producer.responsibility: Единолично хранить active lease set, acquire/release и writer replay identities, выдавать outcomes только после durable ledger readback и допускать writer лишь при пустом active set и отсутствии active writer permit

capabilities: writer admission iff active set empty and no writer permit

inputs.meaning: Авторитетный lookup ledger: NEVER_INITIALIZED, PRESENT(snapshot), MISSING_PREVIOUS, CORRUPT либо UNAVAILABLE
inputs.identity: workspace identity + lookup attempt identity + optional lookup revision + NEVER_INITIALIZED | PRESENT(coordinator_instance_id + state_revision + state_generation + snapshot) | MISSING_PREVIOUS | CORRUPT(stage + cause) | UNAVAILABLE(stage + cause)
inputs.cardinality: exactly 1 lookup outcome per coordinator operation
constraints: NEVER_INITIALIZED requires durable never-created marker
PRESENT alone permits normal operations and contains active_leases keyed by lease_id
PRESENT retains acquire_replays and tagged released identities
PRESENT retains active_writer_permit NONE or writer_permit_id + writer_operation_id + owner_process_identity + previous_generation + baseline_bundle_identity + expected_revision + recovery_deadline
PRESENT retains writer_admission_replays keyed by full writer operation identity as ACTIVE(writer_permit_id, granted_revision) or CLOSED(writer_permit_id, closure_ref)
PRESENT retains writer_closure_replays keyed by writer_permit_id and closure atomically changes the matching admission replay to CLOSED
MISSING_PREVIOUS, CORRUPT and UNAVAILABLE block all writer and lease transitions
UNAVAILABLE never fabricates a revision or empty state
only TERMINAL_RELEASE contains committed terminal identity, idempotency key, terminal_journal_ref and terminal_record_digest

inputs.meaning: Одноразовый запрос создать первый lease ledger из уже опубликованного source/state generation
inputs.identity: workspace identity + published source/state bundle identity + state_generation + never-initialized marker
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 logical bootstrap per never-initialized workspace; exact replay allowed
constraints: requires exclusive publication lock
missing or corrupt previously initialized ledger is not bootstrap
published bundle generation is authoritative

inputs.meaning: Correlated запрос удержать захваченное generation после полного provisional anchor state
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 logical request per completed response assembly; exact retry allowed

inputs.meaning: Закрытый durable readback попытки записать exact proposed lease state
inputs.identity: proposal identity + COMMITTED_EXACT(state_revision + state digest) | NOT_COMMITTED(previous_revision) | UNKNOWN(stage + cause)
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 per pending decision; exactly 1 for every state-changing ledger commit
constraints: COMMITTED_EXACT is produced only after durable replace and exact readback
NOT_COMMITTED proves the prior revision remains authoritative
UNKNOWN cannot authorize a usable lease, release closure, bootstrap, writer permit or recovery action
exact operation retry reopens lookup and may replay an already committed outcome

inputs.meaning: Идемпотентная release identity, созданная только после consume-once terminal
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + lease_id + committed_terminal_identity + idempotency_key + terminal_journal_ref + terminal_record_digest
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 logical request per leased terminal; exact retransmissions allowed
constraints: request exists only after durable PublicResponseTerminalJournal receipt
journal ref and digest are retained unchanged through every retry and replay

inputs.meaning: Запрос source/state writer получить атомарный допуск публикации нового поколения
inputs.identity: workspace identity + coordinator_instance_id + expected state_revision + writer_operation_id + owner_process_identity + baseline bundle identity

inputs.meaning: Авторитетное Windows-наблюдение смерти точного владельца lease
Терминальный COMMITTED либо ABORTED от writer, всё ещё владеющего publication lock
inputs.identity: workspace identity + writer_permit_id + writer_operation_id + COMMITTED(previous_generation + published_generation + bundle_identity) | ABORTED(stage + cause)
inputs.cardinality: exactly 1 logical outcome per granted live writer permit; exact retransmissions allowed until closure readback

inputs.meaning: Авторитетный readback опубликованного bundle после смерти владельца writer permit
inputs.identity: workspace identity + writer_permit_id + authoritative bundle identity + generation + COMMITTED_MATCH|NOT_COMMITTED|AMBIGUOUS + exact stage/cause
constraints: runtime supervisor does not manufacture bundle facts
reader compares durable published marker and bundle digest
AMBIGUOUS preserves the active writer permit

inputs.meaning: Supervisor-owned bounded attempt to resolve one persisted dead writer permit
inputs.identity: workspace identity + writer_permit_id + owner_process_identity + attempt_number + deadline

inputs.meaning: Supervisor-owned bounded attempt разрешить недоказанную запись generation ledger без новой operation identity
inputs.identity: workspace identity + operation_kind + operation_identity + proposal revision/digest + lookup_attempt_identity + attempt_number + deadline + RETRY|EXHAUSTED
constraints: supervisor owns only attempt bound and deadline
ledger remains the sole commit/readback authority
retry preserves the original operation and proposal identity

outputs.meaning: Предлагаемое следующее состояние active leases, replay identities и writer admission до записи ledger
outputs.identity: workspace identity + coordinator_instance_id + next state_revision + state_generation
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 per bootstrap or state-changing acquire, release, writer admission, writer commit/abort/recovery or owner cleanup; exactly 1 only when a usable authoritative lookup yields a candidate; 0 for read-only replay/failure or OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED
outputs.creation_condition: Coordinator под lock вычислил state-changing candidate; authoritative committed state появится только в COMMITTED_EXACT ledger readback
constraints: state_revision strictly increases
writer_admission equals active set empty and active_writer_permit NONE
GRANTED persists active_writer_permit before delivery
writer COMMITTED advances state_generation to exact published generation
writer ABORTED clears permit and leaves generation unchanged
no transition removes an unrelated lease

outputs.meaning: Внутреннее решение state transition до durable ledger confirmation
outputs.identity: workspace identity + operation identity + proposed state revision/digest or NO_STATE_CHANGE + candidate outcome
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 per bootstrap, acquire, release, writer admission/closure/recovery or owner cleanup decision; exactly 1 only after a candidate or NO_STATE_CHANGE decision exists; 0 when the current attempt emits OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED
outputs.creation_condition: Coordinator has decided under lock but has not yet exposed a usable external outcome
constraints: state-changing candidate is unusable before exact durable readback
NO_STATE_CHANGE candidate is tied to the PRESENT lookup revision
failure never exposes an uncommitted permit

outputs.meaning: Типизированный исход недоказанной записи generation ledger для той же операции без usable domain outcome
outputs.identity: workspace identity + operation_kind + operation_identity + proposal revision/digest + NOT_COMMITTED_RETRY(previous_revision) | COMMIT_READBACK_REQUIRED(lookup_attempt_identity + stage + cause + attempt_number + deadline) | COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED(last_lookup_attempt_identity + stage + cause + evidence_ref)
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 current status per state-changing operation; exactly 1 iff no usable domain outcome exists after NOT_COMMITTED, UNKNOWN or exhausted recovery; exactly 0 when a domain outcome or OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED is emitted for the same decision
outputs.creation_condition: Ledger readback did not return COMMITTED_EXACT for the exact proposal or bounded same-operation recovery was exhausted
constraints: no bootstrap, lease, release closure, writer permit, writer closure or process cleanup outcome is exposed
NOT_COMMITTED_RETRY reopens PRESENT/NEVER_INITIALIZED lookup before exact same-operation retry
COMMIT_READBACK_REQUIRED repeats exact lookup/readback with the same operation identity and never starts a new operation
COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED is an operation-level stop, not a domain outcome, permit, release acknowledgement or public terminal
bounded UNKNOWN ends COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED because operator repair is not defined in v1

outputs.meaning: Авторитетный CREATED, ALREADY_CREATED либо BLOCKED результат fresh bootstrap
outputs.identity: bootstrap request identity + CREATED|ALREADY_CREATED|BLOCKED + coordinator_instance_id + state_revision
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 per bootstrap attempt; exactly 1 when a bootstrap domain outcome is available and exactly 0 while OUT-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS or OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED represents the same operation
outputs.creation_condition: Coordinator checks never-initialized marker and published generation under exclusive lock
constraints: CREATED emits revision 1 and empty active/replay maps
ALREADY_CREATED returns exact existing initial snapshot
BLOCKED never invents empty state

outputs.meaning: Закрытый authoritative acquire outcome ACTIVE_ACQUIRED, REPLAYED_TERMINAL, REPLAYED_PROCESS_DIED, CHANGED либо FAILED
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + captured_generation + ACTIVE_ACQUIRED(lease_id, observed, state_revision) | REPLAYED_TERMINAL(lease_id, committed_terminal_identity, terminal_journal_ref, terminal_record_digest, released_revision) | REPLAYED_PROCESS_DIED(lease_id, owner identity, cleanup revision) | CHANGED(observed, state_revision) | FAILED(stage, cause)
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 per logical acquire identity; exactly 1 when an acquire domain outcome is available and exactly 0 while OUT-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS or OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED represents the same operation
outputs.creation_condition: Coordinator resolves a valid acquire request under its state lock
constraints: ACTIVE_ACQUIRED iff exact lease is currently active and durable
REPLAYED_TERMINAL returns prior terminal identity plus authoritative journal ref/digest and never creates permit/envelope/release
journal retention is not shorter than acquire replay retention
REPLAYED_PROCESS_DIED returns recovery-only outcome and never creates permit
CHANGED creates no lease
FAILED changes no state
same assembly with changed generation or owner identity is rejected

outputs.meaning: Закрытый authoritative release/readback outcome RELEASED, ALREADY_RELEASED либо RELEASE_FAILED
outputs.identity: complete release identity + RELEASED|ALREADY_RELEASED|RELEASE_FAILED + state_revision + cause when failed
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 per release attempt or readback; exactly 1 when a release domain outcome is available and exactly 0 while OUT-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS or OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED represents the same operation
outputs.creation_condition: Coordinator compares the complete release identity with active state and replay identities
constraints: RELEASED changes ACTIVE to TERMINAL_RELEASE once
ALREADY_RELEASED requires exact TERMINAL_RELEASE identity
PROCESS_DIED never satisfies terminal ALREADY_RELEASED
RELEASE_FAILED changes no lease
operational failure retains active lease

outputs.meaning: Авторитетный GRANTED, ALREADY_CLOSED, BLOCKED либо RETRY_REQUIRED для source/state writer под coordinator lock
outputs.identity: workspace identity + writer_operation_id + coordinator_instance_id + observed state_revision + GRANTED(first|replayed, writer_permit_id)|ALREADY_CLOSED(writer_permit_id, closure_ref)|BLOCKED|RETRY_REQUIRED
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 per writer admission request; exactly 1 when an admission domain outcome is available and exactly 0 while OUT-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS or OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED represents the same operation
outputs.creation_condition: Coordinator evaluates current state under the publication lock
constraints: new GRANTED iff active lease count is zero, active_writer_permit is NONE and expected revision is current
GRANTED contains a unique writer_permit_id
exact replay of ACTIVE admission returns the same permit
CLOSED admission returns ALREADY_CLOSED with closure_ref and never re-grants capability
BLOCKED may be recomputed only at the same PRESENT revision without state change
a changed revision returns RETRY_REQUIRED and requires a new request identity
conflicting replay is rejected
live writer holds the OS lock only through commit or abort
after owner death durable permit blocks admission while recovery reacquires a new exclusive lock

outputs.meaning: Авторитетный terminal результат фиксации writer COMMITTED, ABORTED либо process recovery
outputs.identity: workspace identity + writer_permit_id + writer_operation_id + COMMITTED|ABORTED|RECOVERED_COMMITTED|RECOVERED_ABORTED + state_revision + state_generation + bundle identity when committed
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 per writer closure attempt or exact readback; exactly 1 when a closure domain outcome is available and exactly 0 while OUT-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS or OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED represents the same operation; terminal variants are replayable
outputs.creation_condition: Coordinator verifies live lock owner or authoritative post-death bundle readback
constraints: commit records exact published generation and bundle identity
abort clears the persisted permit and preserves generation
every terminal closure atomically marks the matching admission replay CLOSED
exact writer_permit replay returns the same closure
recovery never guesses whether publication committed

outputs.meaning: Наблюдаемый отказ операции из-за потерянного, повреждённого либо недоступного generation lease ledger
outputs.identity: workspace identity + operation_kind + operation_identity + lookup attempt identity + optional retained proposal revision/digest + optional lookup revision + MISSING_PREVIOUS|CORRUPT|UNAVAILABLE(stage + cause)
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 per initial operation or exact commit-recovery attempt against MISSING_PREVIOUS, CORRUPT or UNAVAILABLE lookup
outputs.creation_condition: Authoritative lookup is MISSING_PREVIOUS, CORRUPT or UNAVAILABLE before an initial proposal, or while resolving one retained pending proposal under the same recovery identity
constraints: creates no new proposed state
initial path has no proposal; recovery path preserves exact retained proposal revision/digest
mutually exclusive with a new domain outcome and OUT-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS for the same decision
bootstrap is forbidden
no lease or writer permit is granted or released
writer remains blocked
operation owner and diagnostics receive the exact lookup reason

outputs.meaning: Диагностируемый результат удаления только lease точного умершего process owner
outputs.identity: workspace identity + cleanup_event_id + process owner identity + ordered removed(command_id + command_ordinal + command_count + response_assembly_id + lease_id + PROCESS_DIED + cleanup_revision) sorted by lease_id + next state_revision
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 per accepted process-death observation; exactly 1 when a cleanup domain outcome is available and exactly 0 while OUT-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS or OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED represents the same cleanup operation
outputs.creation_condition: Exact owner identity is dead and owned active leases are atomically moved to tagged PROCESS_DIED replay entries
constraints: PID without start time never matches
unrelated leases remain active
duplicate observation is idempotent and returns the same workspace identity, cleanup_event_id and ordered command identities
removed entries are sorted by lease_id lexicographically

each removed identity has one closed disposition: matching OPEN|TERMINAL_COMMITTED(RELEASE_PENDING|RECOVERY_REQUIRED|RECOVERY_BLOCKED) may reach PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED lifecycle, while matching ABSENT may reach PREOPEN_PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED tombstone with durable ACK and without release lifecycle, permit, public terminal or envelope
TERMINAL_COMMITTED(CLOSED|PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED) never receives a new lifecycle transition

outputs.meaning: Одна стабильная idempotent process-death closure command для одного removed lease из durable cleanup batch
outputs.identity: workspace identity + cleanup_event_id + command_id + command_ordinal + command_count + response_assembly_id + lease_id + owner_process_identity + cleanup_revision
outputs.cardinality: 0..N per cleanup event; exactly 1 per removed lease and 0 for an empty removed list
outputs.creation_condition: Durable DeadProcessLeaseCleanupOutcome contains the matching removed entry
constraints: workspace identity, command_id and ordinal are stable on replay
no removed entry is dropped or duplicated
command is not RELEASED or ALREADY_RELEASED
delivery retry preserves the exact workspace-scoped command identity

outputs.meaning: Typed RECOVERY_REQUIRED либо OPERATOR_ACTION_REQUIRED для сохранённого active writer permit
outputs.identity: workspace identity + writer_permit_id + writer_operation_id + owner_process_identity + attempt_number + RECOVERY_REQUIRED(next deadline) | OPERATOR_ACTION_REQUIRED(last stage + cause + evidence bundle)
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 per writer recovery attempt; exactly 1 when a writer recovery domain status is available and exactly 0 while OUT-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS or OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED represents the same recovery operation
outputs.creation_condition: Authoritative bundle readback remains AMBIGUOUS while persisted permit stays active
constraints: status includes the exact confirmed state revision
RECOVERY_REQUIRED routes the same permit to the next bounded attempt
final bounded attempt becomes OPERATOR_ACTION_REQUIRED
writer admission remains blocked
permit is never silently cleared

outputs.meaning: Durable recovery identity, извлечённая из persisted active_writer_permit после точной смерти owner
outputs.identity: workspace identity + writer_permit_id + owner_process_identity + baseline generation + baseline bundle identity
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 per persisted permit whose owner is authoritatively dead
outputs.creation_condition: PRESENT lookup contains matching active_writer_permit and process guard proves exact owner death
constraints: identity is read from durable ledger, not reconstructed by supervisor
permit remains active until durable recovery closure

transformations.rule: Для MISSING_PREVIOUS, CORRUPT или UNAVAILABLE до нового proposal связать exact lookup reason с одной фактически запрошенной operation identity; commit-recovery attempt дополнительно обязан совпасть с retained OUT-LEASE-STATE-PENDING-DECISION. Вернуть typed block владельцу и diagnostics; bootstrap, acquire, release, writer admission/closure и cleanup не выполняются; revision для UNAVAILABLE не выдумывается
Только из PRESENT snapshot и exact PID + start time извлечь persisted active_writer_permit, baseline generation и bundle identity для supervisor recovery; неизвестный owner ничего не создаёт

Под exclusive lock: NEVER_INITIALIZED создаёт candidate revision 1; PRESENT даёт idempotent ALREADY_CREATED candidate; MISSING_PREVIOUS, CORRUPT или UNAVAILABLE обслуживает только приоритетный TR-REJECT-UNAVAILABLE-LEASE-STATE без candidate

Только для PRESENT под одним lock сравнить captured/current и полную acquire identity: создать ACTIVE candidate, вернуть ACTIVE_ACQUIRED replay пока lease active, REPLAYED_TERMINAL либо REPLAYED_PROCESS_DIED после closure, CHANGED при generation mismatch; MISSING_PREVIOUS, CORRUPT и UNAVAILABLE входят только в приоритетный reject transform
Только для PRESENT под одним lock применить exact ACTIVE-to-RELEASED один раз, вернуть ALREADY_RELEASED по точной replay identity либо RELEASE_FAILED без изменения любого lease

Для exact persisted writer_operation replay сначала проверить admission lifecycle: ACTIVE возвращает тот же GRANTED, CLOSED возвращает ALREADY_CLOSED с closure_ref и никогда не re-grant; BLOCKED повторно вычислять только на том же PRESENT revision, а при changed revision возвращать RETRY_REQUIRED для новой request identity; для нового запроса только при PRESENT с актуальными instance/revision, пустым active set и active_writer_permit NONE создать candidate active_writer_permit и ACTIVE admission replay; GRANTED нельзя доставить до durable confirmation; конфликт identity отклонить

Только для PRESENT: для exact writer_permit + writer_operation closure replay вернуть сохранённую closure без state change; иначе проверить live writer permit, operation и владение тем же lock: COMMITTED записывает exact published generation и bundle identity, ABORTED сохраняет generation; обе ветви очищают active_writer_permit, записывают closure replay, атомарно меняют admission replay ACTIVE -> CLOSED(closure_ref) и требуют durable next revision до выдачи outcome

Только для PRESENT после доказанной смерти owner сохранённого active_writer_permit под новым exclusive lock сопоставить supervisor attempt с authoritative bundle readback: COMMITTED_MATCH даёт state-changing RECOVERED_COMMITTED candidate, NOT_COMMITTED даёт state-changing RECOVERED_ABORTED, и обе terminal ветви атомарно меняют admission replay ACTIVE -> CLOSED(closure_ref); AMBIGUOUS создаёт NO_STATE_CHANGE candidate RECOVERY_REQUIRED либо OPERATOR_ACTION_REQUIRED, tied to PRESENT revision; ни один status не выдаётся до durable confirmation/readback

Только для PRESENT по exact PID плюс process start time атомарно перенести только leases умершего владельца в tagged PROCESS_DIED replay entries без terminal/key; неизвестное или повторное наблюдение не меняет state

Для state-changing candidate выпустить usable domain outcome только после COMMITTED_EXACT revision/digest; NOT_COMMITTED и UNKNOWN для любого operation kind выпускают только OUT-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS с исходной operation/proposal identity, без permit/closure/cleanup; unresolved RETRY сохраняет ту же identity, а EXHAUSTED выпускает только COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED; NO_STATE_CHANGE replay/status подтверждается PRESENT lookup revision и обязан ссылаться на durable replay/current permit

После durable cleanup пройти ordered removed list и выдать ровно одну stable command на каждый элемент с теми же workspace identity, cleanup_event_id, command_id, ordinal/count, assembly, lease, owner и cleanup revision; пустой список даёт ноль команд, повтор не меняет identity

preconditions: state-changing proposal computed under publication lock
consumer_obligations: atomically replace the previous snapshot
durably flush and read back COMMITTED_EXACT revision/digest or return NOT_COMMITTED|UNKNOWN
return the closed lookup union NEVER_INITIALIZED|PRESENT|MISSING_PREVIOUS|CORRUPT|UNAVAILABLE
retain lease and writer replay maps
treat missing, corrupt or unavailable historical ledger as writer BLOCKED, never as empty active set
for UNAVAILABLE preserve lookup attempt identity, stage and cause without fabricated revision
handoffs.success: Usable external outcome is emitted only after durable exact readback; the next operation reads one complete authoritative revision
failures: FAILED without writer admission or invented empty state

preconditions: lookup is NEVER_INITIALIZED or exact PRESENT replay
state-changing CREATED has COMMITTED_EXACT ledger readback
consumer_obligations: continue only for CREATED or exact ALREADY_CREATED
on BLOCKED create no source/provenance writer request
never reinterpret MISSING_PREVIOUS|CORRUPT|UNAVAILABLE as fresh bootstrap
handoffs.success: Bootstrap owner receives one authoritative initial-state outcome
acceptance_refs: DT13-A NEVER_INITIALIZED/PRESENT bootstrap and blocked-state matrix

preconditions: state-changing proposal has NOT_COMMITTED or UNKNOWN exact readback
no usable domain outcome was emitted
consumer_obligations: preserve operation_kind, operation_identity and proposal revision/digest
route ACQUIRE to application::public_search and RELEASE to application::thin_search lease release controller; route all other kinds to their declared operation owners
for NOT_COMMITTED_RETRY reopen authoritative lookup before same-operation retry
for COMMIT_READBACK_REQUIRED repeat exact lookup/readback without a new operation identity
for COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED stop the exact operation without permit, release acknowledgement, closure, cleanup or public terminal
handoffs.success: Lost ACK cannot orphan an unobserved bootstrap, lease, release, writer permit, writer closure or process cleanup
acceptance_refs: DT13-A operation-kind x NOT_COMMITTED|UNKNOWN commit matrix
unblocks: same operation only after authoritative resolution

preconditions: request identity validated under coordinator lock
state-changing outcome has durable ledger commit/readback receipt
consumer_obligations: finalize only ACTIVE_ACQUIRED
read back existing terminal for REPLAYED_TERMINAL without new permit
treat REPLAYED_PROCESS_DIED as recovery-only
abort on CHANGED
fail without lease on FAILED
handoffs.success: Public search receives an authoritative mutually exclusive outcome

preconditions: complete release identity compared with active and replay state
state-changing release has durable ledger commit/readback receipt
consumer_obligations: map RELEASED and exact ALREADY_RELEASED to CLOSED
retry operational RELEASE_FAILED with the same identity
handoff recovery to runtime supervisor after request deadline
handoffs.success: One logical release reaches authoritative closure without duplicate state transition
acceptance_refs: DT13-A lost ACK, mismatch and recovery fixtures

preconditions: current state evaluated under publication lock
consumer_obligations: publish only with GRANTED and retained lock
for ALREADY_CLOSED return the referenced closure to the requesting operation without publication or retry
for RETRY_REQUIRED reopen authoritative lookup and use a new request identity
retry BLOCKED only after a changed PRESENT snapshot
never inspect or mutate active set directly
handoffs.success: Writer publication cannot overlap any active generation reader lease
acceptance_refs: DT13-A active A+B, ACTIVE replay, delayed CLOSED replay/ALREADY_CLOSED, RETRY_REQUIRED and writer race fixtures

preconditions: terminal closure has COMMITTED_EXACT ledger readback or is exact retained closure replay
consumer_obligations: COMMITTED and ABORTED complete the live writer operation exactly once
RECOVERED_COMMITTED and RECOVERED_ABORTED complete the dead-writer operation without another publication
return exact closure to delayed ALREADY_CLOSED admission caller
never treat commit recovery status as a closure
handoffs.success: Writer observes one terminal closure and admission remains CLOSED
failures: no closure is emitted for NOT_COMMITTED or UNKNOWN; commit recovery handoff owns them
acceptance_refs: DT13-A COMMITTED/ABORTED/RECOVERED closure and delayed ALREADY_CLOSED fixtures
unblocks: next writer admission after authoritative lookup

preconditions: terminal closure has COMMITTED_EXACT ledger readback or is exact retained closure replay
consumer_obligations: stop recovery for RECOVERED_COMMITTED or RECOVERED_ABORTED
retain exact writer permit, operation and closure revision
schedule no further recovery after any terminal closure
never treat commit recovery status as a closure
handoffs.success: Supervisor ends the exact recovery lifecycle without duplicate publication
failures: no closure is emitted for NOT_COMMITTED or UNKNOWN; commit recovery handoff owns them
acceptance_refs: DT13-A recovered closure and no-further-retry fixtures

handoffs.surface: ProcessDiedReleaseClosureCommand v1 -> required ProcessDiedClosureAck v1 APPLIED|ALREADY_APPLIED|REJECTED_MISMATCH or typed outbox recovery
preconditions: matching removed entry belongs to a durable cleanup event
consumer_obligations: runtime supervisor persists delivery progress by workspace identity + command_id and forwards only coordinator-created commands
process one command item per response lifecycle in the exact workspace

persist workspace identity, cleanup_event_id, command_id, ordinal/count, assembly, lease, owner and revision unchanged with PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED for OPEN|TERMINAL_COMMITTED(RELEASE_PENDING|RECOVERY_REQUIRED|RECOVERY_BLOCKED) or PREOPEN_PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED tombstone for ABSENT
the ABSENT tombstone contains no permit, public terminal, envelope or release
TERMINAL_COMMITTED(CLOSED|PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED) and any workspace/command/lifecycle mismatch return REJECTED_MISMATCH without transition or APPLIED
lost ACK retries the same workspace identity + command_id and never regenerates or renumbers sibling commands
return APPLIED only after COMMITTED_EXACT and byte-identical ALREADY_APPLIED on exact replay
supervisor completes delivery only for matching APPLIED|ALREADY_APPLIED
never treat the command as RELEASED or ALREADY_RELEASED
handoffs.success: Matching OPEN|TERMINAL_COMMITTED(RELEASE_PENDING|RECOVERY_REQUIRED|RECOVERY_BLOCKED) lifecycle reaches PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED or matching ABSENT reaches PREOPEN_PROCESS_DIED_CLOSED; either workspace-scoped disposition has a durable replayable acknowledgement independently of sibling commands
failures: unmatched command remains explicit and replayable
stale command after CLOSED returns REJECTED_MISMATCH without transition or APPLIED
acceptance_refs: DT13-A two-command ordered fan-out, active lease -> ABSENT pre-open tombstone, lost ACK for ABSENT|OPEN|TERMINAL_COMMITTED and idempotent receipt replay fixture
DT13-A two-workspace identity collision across supervisor restart fixture
DT13-A stale command after CLOSED -> REJECTED_MISMATCH with zero transition fixture
unblocks: process-death command delivery completion; release lifecycle closure only for OPEN|TERMINAL_COMMITTED

preconditions: persisted active_writer_permit owner is authoritatively dead
consumer_obligations: start from the exact durable recovery request
for RECOVERY_REQUIRED schedule the same permit with incremented bounded attempt
request bundle facts only from source/state published bundle reader
for OPERATOR_ACTION_REQUIRED preserve block and expose exact evidence
handoffs.success: Writer recovery either reaches durable closure or a typed operator-owned stop
acceptance_refs: DT13-A dead-writer ambiguous readback and escalation fixture

preconditions: authoritative lookup is MISSING_PREVIOUS, CORRUPT or UNAVAILABLE
initial operation has no proposal, or exact recovery operation preserves one retained pending proposal and creates no new proposal
consumer_obligations: route bootstrap to FastSearch source/state bootstrap, acquire to application::public_search, release to thin_search release controller, writer operations to source/state writer and recovery operations to runtime supervisor
show exact stage and cause in diagnostics
never retry as fresh bootstrap or empty ledger
treat recovery as terminal BLOCKED because v1 defines no operator repair request/result
handoffs.success: Every blocked operation has an observable owner and preserves existing unknown lease/writer state
